text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally need human intelligence. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed rules. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks to solve difficult problems, such as recognising faces or understanding speech. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it when we ask a voice assistant a question, when a streaming service suggests a film, or when our phone translates a message into another language. AI is changing the way we live and work.
